name: Пішакова вилка (1)
description: A pawn fork is a double attack executed by a pawn. Despite their limited mobility, pawns can threaten two pieces simultaneously in certain situations. Because pawns are low in value, a pawn fork is a powerful weapon. By forcing a trade, you can exchange the pawn for a much more valuable piece.

examples.text: If a pawn can attack two pieces, it almost always results in a material gain. That is the case here as well. The white pawn in front of the queen forks two black pieces.
The black pieces on the kingside are vulnerable, and White takes advantage of this with a clever pawn fork.

examples.pgn: 17. c5 {[%csl Rb6,Gc5,Rd6][%cal Gc5b6,Gc5d6]} Qh6 18. cxb6 {[%csl Gb6]} *

texts: Check if you can fork two pieces with a pawn.
